text:
E hiwere Monterrey na 20 September 1596 site n’aka Diego de Montemayor, onye kpọrọ ya Ciudad Metropolitana de Nuestra Señora de Monterrey. Isi obodo na obodo kasị ukwuu nke steeti Nuevo León n’ebe ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ Mexico, ọ dị n’ụkwụ ugwu Sierra Madre Oriental ma na-akwado mpaghara obodo nke abụọ kasị ukwuu nke mba ahụ, Monterrey metro nke ihe dị ka nde mmadụ 5.3, yana obodo n’onwe ya nke 1,142,194 e dekọrọ na 2020 census. Obodo ahụ bụ isi ụlọ ọrụ na azụmahịa nke Mexico, nke e wuru na ígwè, ciment, glass, akụkụ ụgbọ ala na ime biya, a na-agụkwa ya n’etiti obodo ndị bara ọgaranya na Latin America. Aha ya bụ La Sultana del Norte na-egosi ọganihu ahụ. Ihe na-ele ya anya bụ Cerro de la Silla, Ugwu Saddle nke na-arị elu ihe dị ka 1,820 m ma bụrụ akara ngosi nke obodo ahụ, nke a na-ahụ site n’ime Estadio BBVA, nke ụdị elu ya na-egosi profaịlụ ugwu ahụ.

Bọọlụ na-agbasa ebe a. Monterrey bụ otu n’ime obodo bọọlụ kacha sie ike na Mexico, nke Clásico Regiomontano derby dị n’etiti C.F. Monterrey, klọb a maara dị ka Rayados nke na-egwu na Estadio BBVA, na Tigres UANL mere ya. Rayados so na klọb ndị kacha aga nke ọma na nke a na-akwado nke ọma na Liga MX, ma bụrụ otu CONCACAF nwere ihe nrite kacha mma na Champions League na Champions Cup. Ihe nketa ahụ na-enye metro ihe nketa dị elu nke dị tupu Estadio BBVA n’onwe ya, nke mepere na 2015.
